api_gaps.statement: No public generator API returns the unmodified twin of an anomaly-path draw: generate_normal(seed) and generate_anomaly(seed) at equal seeds use independent base draws (roster, regimes, T, noise position all diverge; measured seed 42401: normal T=386 roster=(4, 2) vs anomaly T=450 roster=(3, 1)). Reconstructing the twin replays non-public internals, so the twin constructor is new implementation for the execution task, silently approximated nowhere.

Verified paired invariant: at fixed seed, the anomaly-path base (T, regime bounds, roster, noise_seed position) is identical across severities and across non-duration families; duration_anomaly changes T/regimes and pairs within family only.

Verified coupling limit: post-injection noise is signal-dependent (S1 local-variance scaling, S2 local-std-scaled walk), so twin and abnormal differ outside the mask too. Pairing controls the pre-noise base and the noise seed; realized noise differences are part of the contrast, disclosed not fixed.

branches.CONTEXT: Context-only controls move; resolve confounding before any scale claim.
branches.MEASURE-DILUTION: Stage-1 bar met but Stage-2 primary missed; investigate sample-size/measurement dilution.
branches.REPRESENTATION: Stage-1 bar missed at N=96 with clean context; bounded negative, change representation/objective.
branches.SCALE: Stage-1 bar met and Stage-2 primary met, context controls clean.

decision_rule.non_significance: never read as absence; bounded-negative only at the N=96 cap with clean context.
decision_rule.stage1_primary: Detection fraction of per-seed paired contrasts above the frozen null q95; PROPOSED bar >= 0.5 with the exact lower bound above the measured false-alarm anchor (owner approval D4).
decision_rule.stage2_primary: E1 transition median above the context-only control q95 at elevated burden, weekly and monthly; dilution ladder low/mid must show monotone non-increasing response (descriptive).

design.business_baseline_rule: low-nonzero burden in [0.02, 0.10]; pure normal is diagnostic control only
design.grouping_rule: group key = pair seed; every variant (twin + all family/severity abnormals) of one seed stays in one split. Reference pool seeds are disjoint from pair/control seeds. Anomaly labels never enter encoder, reference, prototype, bandwidth or detector fits.
